authority: Canonical machine-readable execution service objective and bounded-tranche policy.

timing.compatibility_note: The legacy 24/16 fields remain temporarily for historical projections and tranche sizing. They are telemetry/risk signals only and may not block a correct terminal state.

execution_envelope.scope: Every execution-mode owner Continue, including product implementation, governance maintenance, research, evaluation, recovery, and other same-lane executable work.
execution_envelope.cycle_identity_rule: The cycle_id is created once for the durable execution run and remains stable across logical operations. Completing a logical operation, research subfacet, tool batch, commit, validation milestone, or artifact does not create a new cycle.
execution_envelope.dynamic_fill_rule: While the durable run is nonterminal and safe same-lane work exists, completion of one logical operation immediately selects the next authorized operation. The executor may not emit a final response merely because a logical operation completed.
execution_envelope.closeout_transition_rule: The 16-minute value is an initial closeout-risk signal, not a mandatory phase boundary. When risk is signaled, optional expansion should leave the critical path, but actual lifecycle state controls progression.
execution_envelope.terminal_rule: Normal terminal response requires actual terminal invariants: terminal lifecycle state, closeout complete where applicable, no pending authorized work, no active required validation/PR/side-effect work, and a passing execution-reconciliation bundle. Elapsed time never grants or withholds terminal authority.
execution_envelope.latency_rule: The initial 24-minute value is an owner-visible latency SLO. Terminal state before 24 minutes closes immediately; terminal state after 24 minutes closes and records an SLO miss; nonterminal state after 24 minutes continues or reports a genuine blocker.
execution_envelope.interruption_rule: If execution is interrupted, persist/resume the same cycle_id and durable state. Conversation change, context compaction, or recovery does not reset execution identity or transfer routine scheduling responsibility to the owner.
execution_envelope.anti_spoof_rule: The executor may not rewrite event-derived latency or interaction facts. Timing thresholds are telemetry and may not be used as substitute evidence for terminal invariants.

execution_reconciliation.scope: Every execution-mode completed_verified terminal attempt after lifecycle state is terminal.
execution_reconciliation.desired_state_rule: The terminal reconciler compares observed execution state to desired_state=terminal_verified. A completed sub-operation or artifact is not desired-state convergence.
execution_reconciliation.operation_identity_rule: Every logical operation has one durable operation_id and one idempotency_key. Retries increment attempts on the same operation record; duplicate operation or idempotency identities are invalid rather than new progress.
execution_reconciliation.side_effect_rule: Externally visible effects have durable effect_id/idempotency_key records and must be verified or compensated before terminal response. Applied-but-unverified effects remain nonterminal.
execution_reconciliation.liveness_rule: Terminal reconciliation requires at least one reconciliation pass and zero consecutive no-progress passes. No-progress is surfaced as an unmet invariant instead of being hidden by narration or repeated reruns.
execution_reconciliation.independent_evidence_rule: At least one passing verification record must be independent of the executor's completion assertion and bound to the active cycle and trace.
execution_reconciliation.resume_identity_rule: Interrupted execution increments resume_generation but resumed_from_cycle_id must equal the active cycle_id. Recovery may not silently create a new execution identity.
execution_reconciliation.trace_rule: Operations, side effects and verification evidence share one trace_id so causal history can be reconstructed across tools, retries, interruption and closeout.
execution_reconciliation.digest_rule: The terminal reconciliation bundle carries a SHA-256 digest over canonical JSON excluding the digest field. Evidence/state mutation after reconciliation invalidates terminal proof.
execution_reconciliation.one_pass_rule: The reconciler returns the complete set of unmet terminal invariants in one pass so repairs are batched before another terminal attempt; one-failure-per-Continue discovery is forbidden.
research_basis: Anthropic long-running agent harnesses externalize progress state instead of relying on model memory
Temporal durable execution replays from persisted history and requires idempotent side-effect handling
Kubernetes controllers repeatedly reconcile observed state toward declared desired state
AWS idempotent retry guidance and transactional outbox patterns separate retry identity from effect identity
SRE readiness and postmortem practice requires evidence-backed operational acceptance
state-machine and fault-injection testing exercise transition sequences and interruption recovery
OpenTelemetry trace-context patterns preserve causal identity across process and tool boundaries

continue_semantics.ordinary_bare_continue: Start or resume the selected durable execution run and carry it through validation, merge, completed_verified closeout, terminal reconciliation and strict successor selection unless a genuine blocker prevents completion.

execution_hardening.event_ledger_rule: Owner interaction, wall latency and other execution facts are derived from an append-only hash-chained event stream. Checkpoint projections may not independently author or override those facts.

execution_routing.canonical_state_rule: Lifecycle phase and next action are derived from the canonical execution record plus observed repository facts; manually authored narrative next-action text is not independent authority.
execution_routing.response_gate_rule: Every reconciled nonclosed execution state emits response_gate=CONTINUE_EXECUTION. A closed lifecycle state emits TERMINATION_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED and is not itself permission to stop; only actual terminal invariants and the termination preflight may authorize a terminal response.
execution_routing.projection_rule: Pointer, authority, runtime and compiled selector rows are materialized views of one canonical execution record and must not independently invent work-item, attempt, status, authority or branch state.
execution_routing.context_rule: Normal execution is restricted to the declared hermetic tranche context. Repository-wide search or undeclared reads require diagnostic_mode=true and a concrete failure_signature.
execution_routing.red_transition_rule: When a focused test exists and required context is resolved, DISPATCH_RED_NOW is the next legal progression. Additional ordinary research/search before RED is non-progress.
execution_routing.validation_generation_rule: Ordinary focused Validation Core profiles are generated deterministically from a small work-item data record and reuse the canonical Linux/Windows validation workflow.

human_ai_team_contract.shared_task_model_rule: The canonical checkpoint, event ledger, state reconciler, response gate and terminal preflight are the shared human-AI task model. Progress narration never substitutes for those state transitions.
human_ai_team_contract.handoff_rule: If context or conversation changes, preserve the same run/cycle/trace identity and next machine action. Do not transfer responsibility back to the owner merely because a model session or logical subtask ended.

repository_capability_preflight.rule: Before any pull-request merge side effect, derive the merge method from a fresh repository capability snapshot. An unsupported requested method returns STOP_UNSUPPORTED_MERGE_METHOD before mutation and is not counted as an execution attempt.

precloseout_readiness.rule: Before publishing completed_verified closeout state, reconcile actual terminal invariants. Elapsed time is returned only as latency-SLO telemetry and cannot block correct terminal state or authorize incomplete state.

atomic_projection.rule: Start and closeout projections that mutate several control-plane paths are constructed from one validated base and published as one Git tree, one commit and one ref update. Multi-file contents-API mutation is prohibited because sequential blob-SHA updates create stale-write and transient-inconsistency risk. Do not create per-tranche temporary workflow files merely to obtain atomic multi-file mutation when Git-object primitives are available.

terminal_proof.rule: A newly completed bounded implementation unit is terminally reconciled inside the already-required canonical-main repository-health run. Do not launch a separate one-shot terminal-proof workflow when canonical-main health can perform the same proof after its authority and regression gates pass.

incremental_validation.application_policy: Reuse compatible per-OS TypeScript incremental metadata while retaining the full declared Linux/Windows typecheck and deterministic comparison acceptance surface.
incremental_validation.checkout_policy: Fetch only the Git history the consumer actually requires. Application exact-head profile jobs use shallow checkout and the comparator uses sparse checkout; AIOC canonical health deliberately retains full ancestry because sealed-baseline and historical maintenance ancestry are part of its acceptance proof.
incremental_validation.fallback_rule: Do not skip full required acceptance work based on impact analysis until a validated dependency graph and deterministic full-suite fallback are in place.

before_product_branch_creation: supply fresh authorized branch plus observed branch/open-PR snapshot
resume the exact authorized branch/open PR when present; never create an alternate duplicate attempt
execution_hardening.validation_evidence_rule: Only evidence whose validated head equals the current candidate head counts toward merge or closeout; superseded heads are non-counting without needing another broad discovery pass.
execution_hardening.closeout_precompute_rule: During current-head validation, precompute all closeout/successor projections that do not depend on final evidence. Leave validated head, validation run, deterministic receipt and merge SHA empty until observed. Before publishing closeout, reconcile actual terminal invariants and record latency telemetry separately.
execution_hardening.terminal_outcome_rule: For legacy governed execution units completed before event-ledger enforcement, the terminal outcome fields remain compatibility projections. For ledger-backed runs, owner_continue_turns and single_continue_achieved are derived from event truth and may not be authored by the executor.
execution_hardening.final_response_rule: Execution mode may emit a terminal final response only after a fresh termination preflight returns ALLOW_FINAL_RESPONSE. Open PR, active current-head validation, merged-with-closeout-pending, a nonterminal lifecycle state, or unreconciled execution identity/effects/evidence are independently nonterminal. Elapsed time alone is never a terminal condition.

external_tool_access.fallback_rule: If a required external development tool is unavailable, expired, trial-limited, or no longer supports the intended AI/development workflow, replace it with a currently verified local/open-source or owner-approved durable alternative before governed start. Do not silently assume access.

projection_rule: Any copied validator/checkpoint/preflight values are generated or checkable projections of this profile and must not become independent authority.
